review.note: Release 0.3.0 adds shared exact-candidate review with mandatory first-repository baselines, fixes Windows unit-test host API isolation, and owns Git hook process trees. New git-flow merges now require repository-local Python, so this release advances the compatibility lane. Reviewed official release notes at https://hatch.pypa.io/dev/history/hatchling/ https://packaging.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html https://build.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html https://mypy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changelog.html https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/changelog.html https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.17.0 and https://github.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2/blob/v0.23.3/CHANGELOG.md . Hatchling 1.32.4 restores its build-hook generic interface; this project uses the standard package builder. Build 1.6.1 fixes Windows symlink detection; packaging 26.3 extends version ranges without requiring API changes here. Explicit py314 target and selected Ruff rules avoid changed defaults; standard strict mypy and Node 26 remain supported. Validated installed hatchling 1.32.4, packaging 26.3, build 1.6.1, mypy 2.4.0, pytest 9.1.1, Ruff 0.17.0 and markdownlint-cli2 0.23.3: 264 independent toolkit tests passed; 50 baseline/chain/policy/path cases and 3 new component-closure regressions passed; strict mypy, Ruff and Markdown passed. A fresh 0.3.0 sdist-derived wheel and all component exports passed the isolated offline distribution check. NT-like interfaces passed 56 process unit cases; native Windows rerun remains pending. Shared online review is POSIX-only; offline verification is portable. No dependency pins, bounds, additions, or quality-policy relaxations. Final exact-candidate review and complete merge gates are separate evidence and remain required before integration.
